layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

Class: a seamless tileable ground texture for a strategy map, seen from straight above, filling the whole image edge to edge with the same calm ground everywhere: no centre, no border, no horizon, no perspective and no single subject. Quiet and low in contrast so pieces stand out over it: a flat base colour with soft slightly lighter and darker drifts and a few small, discrete details scattered evenly.

Subject: cooled volcanic ground seen from straight above, filling the whole image: dark charcoal brown-grey basalt rock #3b3330 with soft flat slightly lighter ash drifts #4a413c and a few tiny scattered dark pebbles, crossed by a few thin jagged branching cracks of glowing molten lava, bright orange #ff7a1a with small yellow #ffd04a cores and a dark rim, each crack narrow, 1 to 3 pixels wide and about one fifth of the image long, spread evenly with plenty of calm dark rock between them.
